_comment: Copy this file to config.json and fill in your values. config.json is gitignored.
_bot_token_help: Get one from @BotFather on Telegram: /newbot, then copy the token it gives you.
_chat_id_help: Send any message to your bot, then open https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates in your browser. Look for 'chat':{id:...}
_start_token_help: Token to scan routes from. Options: WPLS, HEX, eHEX, INC, WETH, PLSX, pDAI, DAI, USDC
_amount_in_help: Simulated trade size in human units (e.g. 1000 = 1000 WPLS). The flash swap borrows this amount; you do not need to hold it.
_min_profit_bps_help: Minimum gross profit in basis points of amount_in before alerting. 0 = alert on any net-positive route. 50 = only alert if profit >= 0.5% of trade size.
_min_net_usd_help: Minimum net profit in USD (after estimated gas) before sending a Telegram alert. Default 0.50 filters out hairline-positive ticks. The CSV scan log still records every best route regardless of this floor.
_scan_interval_help: Seconds between scans. 30 is a reasonable default; below 10 may hit RPC rate limits.
_dedup_help: Suppress repeat Telegram alerts for the same route for this many minutes.
_v3_depth_help: V3 tick intervals to read per pool (1-8). Higher = more accurate for large trades but more RPC calls. 4 matches the browser default.
_triangular_help: Also scan triangular 3-hop routes (S -> Y -> Z -> S). Doubles scan time slightly.
_csv_log_help: Append one row per scan to a CSV recording the single best (most-promising) route that scan, even when it loses money after gas. Great for studying near-misses over time. Set false to disable.
_csv_path_help: CSV file to write. Relative paths are resolved inside the server/ folder; absolute paths are used as-is. The file is gitignored by default.
_rpc_help: PulseChain RPC endpoint(s). The scanner uses the first; the keeper tries all of them in order with timeout + retry/backoff. Add one or two backups for resilience.
_keeper_section: ─── v5.4 keeper (guarded live pilot + inclusion speed + MEV protection) — read server/README.md before --live ───
_live_enabled_help: v5.2.0 GUARDED LIVE PILOT master switch. Default false = the keeper is strictly read-only (simulate-only), exactly like the dry keeper. Sending a real transaction requires ALL THREE: this flag true, the --live CLI flag, AND a valid KEEPER_PRIVATE_KEY env var whose derived address equals the executor's on-chain keeper(). Leaving this false means --live stays read-only. Never set true unless you intend to send real txs from a dedicated, setKeeper()-authorized keeper wallet.
_keeper_enabled_help: Hard global on/off for sending. false = the keeper still detects/simulates but every send is blocked by the guard. Default true (sends still also require the --live flag AND a key).
_executor_help: The deployed ArbExecutor contract the keeper calls execute() on. This is a public contract address, not your wallet.
_poll_help: How often (ms) the keeper polls the chain tip. It only scans when the block advances, so it reacts within one block. 3000 is well under PulseChain's block time; 1000-5000 is reasonable.
_min_profit_usd_help: Minimum simulated net-after-gas USD required to act on a route. Falls back to min_net_usd if unset. Default 0.50.
_max_gas_price_help: Ceiling for the gas bid. Abort a send if the live base gas price (gwei) exceeds this cap, AND cap the v5.3.0 priority bid (gas_priority_mult) so it can never exceed this value. null = no cap. PulseChain gwei is large nominally but costs ~\$0.0015/tx; set a sanity ceiling if you like.
_gas_priority_help: v5.3.0 INCLUSION SPEED: live txs bid this multiple of the live base gas price to land faster and win the inclusion race (we previously arrived ~16 blocks late and the edge was gone). 1.0 = no priority bid; 1.25 = bid 25% over base. The bid is capped at max_gas_price_gwei. On PulseChain even a 1.5x bid costs fractions of a cent.
_max_gas_frac_help: v5.3.0 gas-vs-edge safety guard: do NOT fire if the (priority-boosted) estimated gas cost exceeds this fraction of the simulated GROSS edge. 0.5 = never spend more than 50% of the expected profit on gas. Keeps the priority bid from eating the trade. Set 1 to effectively disable.
_consecutive_revert_help: v5.3.0 circuit breaker: after this many on-chain reverts in a row (consistently losing the inclusion race and burning gas), pause live sending and fall back to sim-only until the keeper is restarted. 0 = disabled. A success resets the streak.
_receipt_wait_help: v5.3.0 receipt accounting: how long (seconds) to poll eth_getTransactionReceipt after a live send before logging realized=pending / error=receipt_timeout and re-checking on later cycles. Ensures realized_usd (col19) and error (col20) are never left blank for a live fire.
_submission_section: ─── v5.4.0 MEV protection — private/bundle submission (read server/README.md § MEV protection) ───
_submission_mode_help: how the signed arb tx is submitted. 'private' (DEFAULT, recommended) = send via BlockFerret private RPC so the tx is held in a private pool and kept OUT of the public mempool until included — stops public-mempool front-running / MEV sandwiching. 'public' = broadcast to the public RPC mempool (old v5.3.0 behaviour, fastest/widest coverage but exposed to front-running). 'bundle' = v5.5.0 FULLY FUNCTIONAL atomic eth_sendBundle to the /builders endpoint with an on-chain builder tip (executeAndPay) — the pro-searcher lane to fix inclusion when thin-edge private fires keep expiring un-included. REQUIRES: (1) the v5.5.0 ArbExecutor deployed and its address pasted into executor_address, and (2) FLASHBOTS_IDENTITY_KEY set in the env (bundle needs a signed identity header). If FLASHBOTS_IDENTITY_KEY is missing while live, bundle falls back to 'private' at startup with a warning. Unknown values fall back to 'private'.
_private_rpc_url_help: v5.4.0: BlockFerret private single-tx RPC endpoint (eth_sendRawTransaction, no auth, no payment). Used when submission_mode='private'. Trade-off: private inclusion is not every-block (BlockFerret builds only the blocks its validators propose — roughly a minority of blocks via the Vouch relay, ~11% coverage), so a private tx may wait; the tight private_tx_deadline_s ensures a non-included tx expires harmlessly rather than landing stale. Fewer trades that are never front-run beats many trades picked off.
_bundle_rpc_url_help: BlockFerret bundle endpoint (eth_sendBundle, atomic). Used when submission_mode='bundle'. v5.5.0 enables it fully: the keeper signs an identity header with FLASHBOTS_IDENTITY_KEY and fires the executeAndPay() tx that pays the (dynamic, live-fetched) SearcherPaymentRouter a tip from realized profit (split 60% validator / 40% builder) — the on-chain payment the current ArbExecutor could not make before v5.5.0.
_private_tx_deadline_help: v5.4.0: execute() deadline window (seconds from now) used for private/bundle sends, replacing tx_deadline_s in those modes. Deliberately tight so a private tx that is NOT included promptly expires on-chain (reverts, gas only) instead of landing stale after the edge is gone. Range 5–1800; default 30. Public mode keeps using tx_deadline_s.
_bundle_tip_bps_help: v5.5.0: INFORMATIONAL mirror of the deployed ArbExecutor's on-chain tipBps (basis points of realized profit paid to the builder as the inclusion tip). 1000 = 10%. The ACTUAL tip is computed and paid ON-CHAIN by the contract's tipBps (set at deploy via TIP_BPS or later with setTipBps), AFTER the minProfit guard — so a reverting trade never tips. Keep this value matching the deployed tipBps so banner/notices read true. Range 0–5000 (cap 50%).
_bundle_blocks_help: v5.5.0: how many consecutive target blocks each fire's bundle is submitted for (eth_sendBundle per block). The builder context is fetched live per fire; later blocks get the same signed raw tx re-targeted. More blocks = more inclusion chances per fire within the private_tx_deadline_s window. Range 1–10; default 3.
_onchain_guard_help: On-chain minProfit is set to this fraction of the simulated edge. 0.9 = the tx reverts (losing only gas) unless >=90% of the expected profit still exists at inclusion. This is the core safety guard against the one-block edge closing.
_tx_deadline_help: Seconds added to now for the execute() deadline param. The tx reverts if not mined within this window.
_gas_limit_buffer_help: Percent added to eth_estimateGas for the send gas limit, to avoid out-of-gas on slight state drift.
_max_position_help: v5.2.0 guardrail: cap per-trade notional in USD. Any fire whose optimal-size notional (start-token size × live USD price) exceeds this is skipped. Bounds how much capital a single live trade can route. Default 400.
_max_trades_help: Kill switch: stop sending after this many trades in a UTC day. Counter resets at UTC midnight.
_max_daily_loss_help: v5.2.0 kill-switch: halt live sending for the rest of the UTC day once cumulative realized loss reaches this USD. Loss = gas spent on reverted/failed txs PLUS any trade that realized below its gas cost. The keeper keeps scanning/simulating/logging — it just stops sending. Resets at UTC midnight. Default 5.00.
_max_sim_help: Max routes to simulate per block (best-first). The keeper acts on the first that passes; the rest are logged.
_keeper_csv_help: Keeper's own CSV log (separate from the scanner's scan_log.csv). Relative paths resolve inside server/. Gitignored by default.
_keeper_key_help: The live keeper private key is supplied ONLY via the KEEPER_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable at launch — there is NO config/file key source (removed in v5.2.0). The key is never read from disk, written, logged, or committed. Use a DEDICATED low-balance keeper wallet, authorized on-chain with setKeeper(<addr>).
_shadow_enabled_help: v5.1.2 shadow sizing telemetry: run ONE extra read-only callStatic on the best route each block (SIMULATE-ONLY, never sends) to log engine-vs-chain profit side-by-side. Set false to disable.
_shadow_band_help: Only shadow-simulate when the best route's engine opt_net_usd >= min_profit_usd - shadow_band_usd. Captures near-miss wide-gap events the conservative engine under-sizes below the fire floor. Adds at most one eth_call per block, only in-band. Writes shadow_cs_net_usd (on-chain callStatic net USD at the engine's optimal size), shadow_cs_prof_tok (raw profit in start token), shadow_ratio (callStatic profit / engine profit; >1 means the engine under-estimated).
